name: Lisdexamfetamine / KCNMA1-N999S PNKD
preserved_limits: The six human cases were selected as known responders; no all-treated response probability is identifiable.
Mouse drug was dextroamphetamine sulfate, not oral lisdexamfetamine.
No evidence of a new independent proprietary article.
Asp789Glu and Asn536His cases remain distinct from N999S/Asn1053Ser alias.
inference: Strengthens the existence of genotype-related pharmacological symptom modulation; does not repair clinical selection bias or identify the immediate stimulant mechanism.
decision: retain highest clinical-research reserve below leading three
claim_advance_condition: Independently adjudicated useful event/function benefit beyond selected responders, with complete starts/discontinuations and acceptable coverage/burden.
claim_stop_condition: No meaningful adjudicated event benefit, only attention/arousal change, or unacceptable treatment burden.
asset_gate: Concrete differentiated contribution and credible development/rights route.
